items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I worked in there with Billie Holiday... See, we made some of those first recordings with Billie, 'Miss Brown to You,' and 'What Living Moonlight Can Do'

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, they'd give us a break on the drinks, I just forget what it was to tell the truth. One night Frank Sinatra got in a fight down there listening in on our group. Somebody got up and stood in front of-- I've got that somewhere in one of my scrap books--where he punched some guy in the eye for standing in front of him. He said, Man, I want to listen to Cozy's trio. So that was a great gig there, I worked in there with Billie Holiday, Hot Lips Page.
